Hi team — quick handoff. ClearSlate signed the SOW (attached) and kickoff is targeted for Thursday 11/14. Key points from the AE:

- Account: ClearSlate AI (PO issued; DocuSign link below)
- Initial scope: host one production workspace (us-west-2), seed 3 admin API keys and one service account for batch ingestion, configure RBAC for Admin / Dev / Analyst roles
- Security asks: they requested KMS integration (AWS KMS) and evidence of SOC2 attestations for logging pipeline

Grace/Monica: can you own the kickoff and tenant activation items below? Karthik/Jonas: we'll need a quick timeline for key seeding and SCIM/SSO prep.

Thanks Ben — looping in a short activation plan so we can be ready for Thursday.

High-level kickoff agenda (30m):
- 5m intros & scope confirmation
- 10m tenant topology: projects, roles, and API key model
- 10m security & compliance: KMS, audit logs, rotation cadence
- 5m next steps & responsibilities

Questions for ClearSlate before kickoff:
1) Do you want initial admin keys issued as long-lived keys (rotated by Redwood) or short-lived service tokens (recommended)?
2) Do you have SAML SSO metadata ready or prefer invite-only admin accounts first?
3) AWS region preference confirmed: us-west-2?

I can schedule the kickoff for Thu 11/14 at 11:00 PST — Emily/Tom, does that work?

Action items I propose now (will publish shared MLP in Drive):
- Grace: schedule kickoff + invite agenda (Drive link below)
- Monica: prep onboarding checklist and seat mapping from attached spreadsheet
- Karthik: pre-seed admin API keys in a disabled state; leave key placeholders and rotate on go-live
- Jonas: confirm KMS integration tasks and list of evidence we can provide for SOC2 logging

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Onboarding/ClearSlate/Onboarding-Playbook

Cheers,
Grace

Subject: Re: ClearSlate signed — handoff for org activation & admin key seeding

Thanks Ben and Grace — excited to get started. Quick answers and a couple items to add:

- Kickoff: Thu 11/14 11:00 PST works for us.
- Admin keys: prefer short-lived tokens with automated rotation for production; for an initial quickstart we can accept 30d keys if needed but plan to move to short-lived within 2 weeks.
- SSO: we don't have SAML metadata ready; we'll start with invites for 3 admin emails: emily.zhang@clearslate.ai, tom.blake@clearslate.ai, ops+admin@clearslate.ai
- KMS: we'll be using AWS KMS (alias/aws/redwood) and require an envelope encryption model. Please confirm Redwood's KMS integration steps and whether we need to exchange IAM role ARNs.
- Security evidence: security team asked for a list of audit log retention windows and the SOC2 report. Please send SOC2 link and typical retention period for admin audit logs.

Also attaching a short procurement note: procurement expects activation to start after license provisioning complete — estimated by EOD 11/15.

Thanks,
Emily

[Attachment: clearslate-procurement-note.pdf]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearslate.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2029 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: ClearSlate Kickoff: mutual action plan & owners (follow-up)

Great — confirmed Thu 11/14 11:00 PST. Below is a compact mutual action plan (MAP) we'll review at kickoff. I'll post a formal MAP to the Drive/HubSpot after the call.

1) Tenant & admin provisioning (Grace / Karthik) — by 11/15 EOD
   - Create ClearSlate production workspace in us-west-2
   - Seed three admin API keys in disabled state (placeholders pushed to Vault); enable on go-live
   - Create service account for batch ingestion, scoped to Project: ingestion-prod

2) Security & key management (Jonas) — by 11/15
   - Confirm AWS KMS role handshake: please email the IAM role ARN to onboarding@redwood.com or paste into the HubSpot ticket
   - Provide SOC2 summary and audit-log retention statement (we will attach to HubSpot)

3) Invites and SSO (Monica) — by 11/14 pre-call
   - Send invites to emily.zhang@clearslate.ai, tom.blake@clearslate.ai, ops+admin@clearslate.ai
   - If SAML not ready by go-live, we'll keep invite-only admins and add SAML later
4) Procurement & billing (Ben) — coordinate PO completion and confirm license activation window (ClearSlate target 11/15)

Notes / links:
- HubSpot ticket: HS-44278
- Onboarding playbook: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Onboarding/ClearSlate/Onboarding-Playbook
- Checklist attached: initial-tenant-checklist.xlsx

Emily — two small asks before the call: share the IAM role ARN for KMS access and confirm whether you want key rotation fully managed by Redwood or dual-managed (Redwood rotation + ClearSlate KMS rewrap). If you reply in-thread, I’ll pin into the HubSpot note.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Grace
